# Branch-secretariat loyalty target (0..100), re-read every month; the same for all six in step 1:
#   base 80
#   -20 x vanilla factional-strife intensity (CHI var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity; vanilla treats a missing
#     variable as 1, see chi_adjust_pre_rtr_modifiers; its events move it by 0.05 to 0.25)
#   -10 while CHI has yua_dictator_powers (Bayan as dictator, vanilla china_set_up)
#   -20 while the vanilla Red Turban situation is active
# At the 1337 start: 80 -20 -10 = 50.
oe_yp_loyalty_target_value = {
    value = 80
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_variable = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity } }
        add = { value = c:CHI.var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity multiply = -20 }
    }
    else = { add = -20 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_country_modifier = yua_dictator_powers } } add = -10 }
    if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:red_turban_rebellions } add = -20 }
    min = 0
    max = 100
}
